title: Can I Find Myself in Infinite Craft?
summary: He plays Infinite Craft (neal.fun): drag two element chips together to craft a new concept. He crafts chess-related elements (e.g. Chess + Fire, Checkmate) and finally tries to craft 'Want' + 'Checkmate' = 'iwantcheckmate'.
rules: Infinite Craft mechanics: canvas with starting elements (Water, Fire, Wind, Earth); drag one chip onto another to combine; an LLM names the result; new results join the sidebar.
Target chain: reach Chess -> Checkmate -> iwantcheckmate.

board.shape_notes: no chessboard; white crafting canvas with element chips
board.theme_notes: Infinite Craft: white canvas, rounded grey-bordered chips with emoji + label

current_impl_issues: Legacy 'craft' mode (merge pieces into knook) is an invention; the video is a word-crafting game. A remake would need a curated combination table ending at 'iwantcheckmate'.
